passages.title: Eby pledges new Built in B.C. and Canada buying rules
passages.quote: and Canada” buying rules Share Share Conservatives would roll over for Trump, cut projects, abandon workers during trade war MAPLE RIDGE – To drive British Columbia’s economic growth in the face of Trump’s trade war and create good jobs for people here, David Eby has committed to bring in new “Built in B.C. and Canada” procurement rules for public infrastructure projects. “With Donald Trump attacking our workers and businesses, we must become our own best customer – making sure we leverage our historic plan to build schools, hospitals, and transportation projects to create more opportunities for people in B.C.,” said David Eby, BC NDP leader.
